$comment: Hash of each frozen version's slice in the dump it was blessed from, excluding doc/description/examples (none of which reach the generated output), taken off the parsed dump before generation runs (see lib/dump-digest.mts). Generation fails if a frozen version's slice moves, because its files are skipped and the rest of the tree would be generated against a model they no longer hold. Run `yarn generate:api` and paste what it prints to seed a version. Record $source when you do.
$source: ghcr.io/truenas/middleware:master, middlewared 20260907235919~truenas+1 (digest sha256:2206cdcf64e40c3de3f8c8eb0ddbcf3e54ce06943ab2f6c45a97f91967f82126, fetched 2026-09-08). Re-seeded together with a regeneration of v25.10.0-v25.10.5 from this same dump, so the hashes and the frozen files describe one model rather than two. The app.query/AppEntry disagreement recorded at the previous seed has not closed and has not moved: it still sits in v25_10_0, where both shapes are homed and which is frozen, and in v26_0_0, which declares its own narrow AppEntry and inherits the root's widened event; v27_0_0 is still consistent. src/generated-known-gaps.spec.ts passes unchanged on this dump, which is what says so. As at the previous seed, this is not a clean 25.10 snapshot: it is master describing historical versions, and it backports more into those slices than the 2026-08-28 dump did — service.start, service.stop, service.restart and service.reload are now described in every 25.10 slice, and PoolDatasetEntry splits into an Input variant and gains a tier field. That master describes 25.10 that way is not evidence a shipped 25.10 appliance answers to it. The virt.* namespace and pool.dataset.encryption_algorithm_choices are hand-restored after generation; no dump reproduces either, in any version.
